settings.heading: How shipping works
settings.text:
Processing

We pack and dispatch in-stock orders within 1-2 business days. Orders placed on weekends or public holidays are processed on the next business day. If an item is backordered, its product page says so before you buy, and we ship it as soon as it arrives.

Delivery times and costs

Delivery time depends on your location and the shipping method you choose. The available methods, prices and estimated delivery times for your address are shown at checkout.

Tracking

As soon as your order ships we send a confirmation email with your tracking number. You can also check the status from the link in your order confirmation email or from your account.

Problems with delivery

If your tracking hasn't updated for several days, or your parcel arrives damaged, contact us with your order number and we'll sort it out with the carrier.
